scripts.build: npm run copy:vendor-js && npm run copy:vendor-icons && npm run sass:build && npm run sass:build:pdf
scripts.verificar: php scripts/verificar-assets.php && php scripts/verificar-ids.php && php scripts/verificar-vistas.php
scripts.sass:build:pdf: sass resources/scss/pdf/constancia.scss public/assets/css/pdf/constancia.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && sass resources/scss/pdf/ficha-estudiante.scss public/assets/css/pdf/ficha-estudiante.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && sass resources/scss/pdf/nomina-seccion.scss public/assets/css/pdf/nomina-seccion.css --style=expanded --no-source-map
scripts.copy:vendor-js: mkdir -p public/assets/js/vendor && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js public/assets/js/vendor/ && cp node_modules/sweetalert2/dist/sweetalert2.all.min.js public/assets/js/vendor/
